**Visual Analysis of Test Image:**
- Tomato leaf with dark brown/black necrotic lesions
- Lesions are irregular in shape, medium-to-large sized
- No concentric rings visible (rules out Early_Blight/Target_Spot)
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew)
- No mosaic/mottling pattern (rules out virus classes)
- Dark, somewhat water-soaked appearing lesions on green tissue

**Comparison with Late_Blight reference:**
The bottom-right panel in the Late_Blight collage shows a nearly identical presentation — a green tomato leaf with irregular dark brown/black necrotic patches of similar size, shape, and distribution. The irregular (non-circular) nature of the lesions, their dark coloration, and the background gray surface all match the test image very closely.
